verdict.rationale: Fastmail offers rule-based automations that run without the user present: Filters & Rules, Scheduled Send, and snooze that returns messages to the Inbox later. It also exposes a JMAP API with API tokens and push (EventSource/WebPush), so a user could build their own background agents. However, the docs are mostly bare article titles, and none of this is an agentic or AI-driven automation feature, so autonomous AI workflows require external tooling. Missing for 10: native AI/agent-driven background automations, detailed documentation of what Filters & Rules can do autonomously, hands-on or community corroboration of background automation workflows.
